description: A formal request submitted by a customer to FirstUK Bank to obtain a copy of their personal data. The bank must respond within 30 days (extendable to 2 months for complex requests) with data compiled from all systems, subject to permissible redactions.
context: Customer Right: Obtain copy of personal data

name: Customer Identity Verification Control
description: A security control requiring verification of customer identity and potential request for additional identification documents before processing a Subject Access Request, with fraud prevention checks integrated.

name: Staff Privacy Training Policy
description: A mandatory annual privacy training policy requiring all staff to complete 1-hour GDPR training with certification. The policy covers privacy rights, data handling, and breach reporting obligations, with disciplinary action as the consequence of non-compliance.
context: Mandatory Annual Training: All staff: 1-hour GDPR training
Topics: Privacy rights, data handling, breach reporting

name: Mandatory Annual GDPR Training Completion
description: All staff must complete a 1-hour GDPR training course annually with certification. This is a mandatory compliance obligation for all employees.

name: Privacy Rights and Data Handling Training Coverage
description: Staff training must cover privacy rights, data handling procedures, and breach reporting obligations as core topics within the mandatory annual GDPR training.
context: Topics: Privacy rights, data handling, breach reporting

name: All Staff
description: All employees are responsible for completing mandatory annual GDPR training and maintaining certification in privacy and data handling obligations.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The GDPR is the regulatory basis for the mandatory staff privacy training policy, requiring organizations to ensure staff understand privacy rights, data handling, and breach reporting obligations.
key_obligation: staff training on privacy rights and data handling
context: Privacy rights, data handling, breach reporting

name: Data Breach
description: Data breach is identified as a key risk category that staff must be trained to recognize, report, and respond to appropriately under the privacy training policy.
context: Topics: Privacy rights, data handling, breach reporting

name: Privacy Violation
description: Privacy violations and improper data handling are identified as risks that the mandatory staff training is designed to mitigate through education on privacy rights and data handling procedures.
context: Topics: Privacy rights, data handling, breach reporting

name: Staff Training Program
description: A mandatory annual 1-hour GDPR training program delivered to all staff with certification requirement, designed to control privacy and data handling risks through staff education.
context: Mandatory Annual Training: All staff: 1-hour GDPR training

name: Data Protection Compliance Policy
description: A policy governing data protection compliance obligations, including annual GDPR testing, data protection control testing, subject access request handling, and breach response procedures. The policy is subject to regulatory oversight by the Information Commissioner's Office and includes periodic inspections and privacy by design assessments.

name: Annual GDPR Compliance Testing
description: A mandatory annual testing requirement to verify compliance with GDPR obligations. This provision is part of the internal audit function and ensures ongoing adherence to data protection regulations.

name: Data Protection Control Testing
description: A requirement to test data protection controls as part of internal audit procedures. This ensures that technical and operational safeguards protecting personal data are functioning effectively.

name: Subject Access Request Sampling
description: A sampling-based audit procedure to verify that subject access requests are being handled in compliance with data protection obligations. This provision ensures quality and timeliness of responses to data subject requests.

name: Breach Response Procedures Audit
description: An internal audit requirement to test and verify the effectiveness of breach response procedures. This ensures the organization can respond promptly and appropriately to data protection incidents.

name: Privacy by Design Assessment
description: A regulatory audit requirement to assess whether privacy by design principles are embedded in the organization's systems, processes, and operations. This is conducted periodically as part of data protection inspections.

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: The primary EU data protection regulation governing the processing of personal data. The policy mandates annual compliance testing and periodic inspections to ensure adherence to GDPR requirements.

name: Information Commissioner's Office Examination
description: Regulatory oversight and examination authority responsible for data protection compliance in the UK. The ICO may trigger examinations and conduct periodic data protection inspections of the organization.

name: Data Breach
description: The unauthorized access, loss, or compromise of personal data. The policy addresses this risk through breach response procedures that are subject to internal audit testing and regulatory inspection.

name: Data Protection Control Testing
description: An internal audit control mechanism that tests the effectiveness of data protection controls. This measure verifies that technical and operational safeguards are functioning as designed.

name: Subject Access Request Sampling
description: An audit sampling control that verifies subject access requests are being processed and responded to in compliance with data protection obligations. This ensures quality assurance of data subject request handling.

name: Breach Response Procedures
description: Operational procedures designed to detect, respond to, and report data protection breaches. These procedures are subject to internal audit testing to ensure effectiveness and compliance.

name: Privacy by Design Assessment
description: A regulatory audit control that evaluates whether privacy principles are embedded throughout the organization's systems, processes, and operations. This is conducted periodically as part of data protection inspections.

name: Internal Audit Function
description: The organizational function responsible for conducting annual GDPR compliance testing, data protection control testing, subject access request sampling, and breach response procedure audits. This function reports on compliance status and control effectiveness.

name: Information Commissioner's Office
description: The UK regulatory authority responsible for data protection oversight. The ICO has authority to conduct examinations and periodic data protection inspections to verify organizational compliance with data protection obligations.

name: Information Commissioner's Office Fine
description: The Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) is the UK's independent authority for data protection. The ICO has authority to impose financial penalties for regulatory breaches, with fines reaching up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover, whichever is higher.
context: ICO fine: Up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover (whichever higher)

name: Regulatory Breach
description: Failure to comply with regulatory requirements, resulting in potential financial penalties, reputational damage, and loss of customer trust. The document identifies regulatory breaches as a material risk with significant consequences.
context: Breach Consequences: ICO fine: Up to £20 million or 4% of annual turnover (whichever higher)

name: Reputational Damage
description: Loss of market standing and public confidence resulting from regulatory breaches or compliance failures. The document identifies reputational damage as a direct consequence of regulatory non-compliance.

name: Customer Trust Loss
description: Erosion of customer confidence and loyalty following regulatory breaches or compliance failures. The document identifies customer trust loss as a material consequence of regulatory non-compliance.

name: Internal Disciplinary Action for Regulatory Breach
description: The organisation will take internal disciplinary action against staff or management responsible for regulatory breaches. This provision establishes accountability and consequences for non-compliance at the individual level.

name: Policy Review and Updates Framework
description: A policy framework governing the periodic review and update cycle for banking policies, with mandatory annual review frequency or upon GDPR regulatory changes. This framework establishes the cadence and triggers for policy maintenance and ensures compliance documentation remains current.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
description: Mandatory requirement that policies be reviewed on an annual basis, or more frequently if triggered by changes to GDPR or other regulatory requirements. This provision ensures policies remain aligned with current regulatory obligations.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

name: GDPR Change Trigger for Policy Review
description: Provision requiring an immediate policy review and update whenever GDPR or related data protection regulations change, outside the standard annual review cycle. This ensures the bank maintains compliance with evolving regulatory requirements.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or on GDPR change)

name: General Data Protection Regulation
description: European Union data protection regulation that triggers policy review and update obligations when substantive changes occur. The policy explicitly references GDPR as a regulatory driver for out-of-cycle policy maintenance.

name: Data Retention Policy
description: A formal policy governing the retention, storage, and lifecycle management of customer and operational data within the bank. Referenced as a related document that complements data security and processing obligations.

name: Cookie Policy
description: A public-facing policy that governs the use of cookies and similar tracking technologies on the bank's digital platforms. Addresses customer consent and data privacy obligations.

name: Data Security Architecture
description: The technical infrastructure and safeguards implemented to protect customer and operational data. Referenced as a foundational control supporting data protection and compliance obligations.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A template agreement that governs the terms and conditions under which the bank processes personal data on behalf of customers or third parties. Establishes contractual safeguards and accountability for data handling.

name: Data Protection Officer
description: Role responsible for data protection governance and policy approval. The Data Protection Officer approved this document on 2026-01-15, indicating accountability for data protection compliance.

name: Head of Compliance
description: Senior compliance role with authority to approve policy documents. The Head of Compliance approved this document on 2026-01-15, indicating responsibility for compliance policy governance.

name: Chief Executive Officer
description: Executive leadership role with ultimate authority over policy approval. The Chief Executive Officer approved this document on 2026-01-15, indicating board-level accountability for policy governance.
